Escape while running takes back the running turn; else closes the terminal (isTerminalVisible = false); else toggles the diff off; else returns false and falls through
Return while a turn runs calls runtime.interruptAndSend(); with heads at work the runtime queues instead, because heads run inside the lead's session and a stop would kill them

Command-Return (steer) calls queueDraftAsFollowUp only when runtime.canQueue and ShortcutStore.shared.chord(for: .queueChat) == KeyChord(keyCode: 36, modifiers: .command); otherwise it just sends, so rebinding the chord degrades to send

Up/Down recall walks runtime.sentPrompts (non-empty only) and only when the draft has no attachments and the text is empty or matches the recalled entry; going past the newest clears the text and the history index
Backspace at the caret start removes the draft command first, then the last quote, both animated with Chrome.panelSlide
The suggestion word scan walks back from the caret to the previous space (0x20), newline (0x0A) or tab (0x09)
@ mentions produce Suggestion(value: "@<path> ", title: lastPathComponent, detail: path, symbol: "doc")

Slash commands require start == 0 (the word must begin the text); built-ins are /plan "Turn plan mode on or off" always, plus /compact "Summarize the conversation to free up context" for providers .codex, .claude, .copilot, .deepseek, .meta, .zai and .pi

Command suggestions use symbol "command" for built-ins and "sparkles" otherwise, with value "/<name> "; picking one clears the typed text and sets runtime.draft.command = DraftCommand(name:detail:isBuiltIn:) under Chrome.panelSlide
Escape with the list open sets dismissedSuggestions = true so the list stays closed until the caret moves again
Blur only clears the suggestions when the click was not inside the popover (controller.isClickInsideSuggestions()), and cancels the in-flight refresh first

TabSlot shows FollowUpQueueTab while runtime.followUps is non-empty, else ThreadChangesTab when showsChanges and changeStats != nil, both with .transition(.softAppear); the slot exists only while a tab does, or the negative stack overlap would pull the box up
The changes tab's tap clears diff focus, nils diffAnchor and diffSelection, then sets isDiffVisible = true last so a redundant write never restarts the diff load

ContextMeter is hidden entirely when model.settings.showsUsagePanel is true, or when there is no fraction, no plan limits and no credits; the popover's arrow button sets showsUsagePanel = true and closes itself
compactModelChip (floating panels) drops the ContextMeter and collapses the model chip to the provider icon; a floating panel's box also passes takesFocusOnAppear false and showsChanges false
FileIndex: one shared per-directory index in a RecentCache with limit 2 and freshness 60 seconds, at most two concurrent builds; a stale index is served while a rebuild runs behind it

FileIndex search scores: exact name 1000, name prefix 800, substring in name 600, substring in the full lowercased path 400, subsequence 100, each minus lengthPenalty = min(path.count, 99); default limit 8; cancellation checked every 2,048 entries; an empty query returns the first `limit` entries

FileIndex.list prefers git-tracked files capped at 60,000 paths, else a FileManager enumeration capped at 20,000 results, skipping node_modules, build, dist, .build, DerivedData, Pods and target and anything deeper than enumerator level 16
ASCII fast paths use memmem and memchr; a carriage return byte (13) in the haystack forces the grapheme-aware slow path, in both contains and isSubsequence
One suggestion refresh per keystroke: the previous Task is cancelled, because the text view reports a keystroke as both a change and a caret move
The composer's body is deliberately split so a keystroke touches only the text column and the draft-empty send reader, and a diff revision bump touches only ChangeStatsRefresh

Whether .softAppear is a custom transition extension and its exact parameters is not visible here.

Image extensions that get a photo thumbnail: png, jpg, jpeg, heic, heif, gif, tiff, tif, bmp, webp (compared lowercased)
Thumbnails are requested at previewPointSize 30 with fillingSquare: true and keyed by url.path; items and isLoaded are published before the thumbnails arrive so rows appear immediately and fill in

Both the thumbnail branch and the icon branch report their screen frame via ScreenFrameReader, so an icon row's flight never starts from the screen corner
The hover highlight animates with Chrome.hover
The popover's height is fixed at open time, which is why a full 15-row height is assumed while the folder is still being read
unresolved_questions: PopoverMenu's exact handling of maxHeight versus idealHeight, and the breakdown of the 106-point allowance (section header + divider + the two footer items), are defined in PopoverMenu outside this bundle.

files.purpose: The horizontal attachment strip for an editor-style composer that binds an [Attachment] array directly, mirroring the chat composer's DraftAttachments strip but driven by a Binding instead of by ThreadRuntime.
state_owned: @State drawn: Set<Attachment.ID> = [] (which cells have already appeared, so AttachmentArrival fires once per attachment)
side_effects: Removes attachments from the bound array on the delete badge tap
preview.retire(except:) on every attachments change and preview.close() on disappear
platform_assumptions: SwiftUI on macOS with SF Symbols ("xmark.circle.fill") and .symbolRenderingMode(.palette)
ui_elements: ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false) wrapping HStack(spacing: 0)
AttachmentThumbnail(attachment:size: 48, preview:)

Delete badge: Image(systemName: "xmark.circle.fill"), .symbolRenderingMode(.palette), .foregroundStyle(.white, .black.opacity(0.6)), .padding(4), .buttonStyle(.plain), .offset(x: 6, y: -6), overlay alignment .topTrailing

Cell insets: .padding(.top, 2) and .padding(.trailing, 8) (source comment: the pill already leaves 12 above the strip, and 12 + 2 puts the photo 14 from the pill's top edge, matching the 14 leading inset)
Accessibility label Text("Remove \(attachment.name)")
feature_notes: Each newly added attachment is wrapped in AttachmentArrival(isNew: !drawn.contains(id)), so exactly one flight animation plays per pick; the drawn set is updated in .onAppear
The strip shares one AttachmentPreviewCoordinator via AttachmentAnchorCapture, so every draft photo opens in a single tap
Unlike DraftAttachments in ComposerView.swift, this strip's delete button does not call .focusable(false)
unresolved_questions: No call site for EditorAttachments is in this bundle, so whether it is currently presented in shipped UI (and by which editor surface) could not be confirmed from these files.

The relationship between AttachmentPreviewCoordinator used here and AttachmentPreviewSlot used by ComposerView.swift's DraftAttachments, which share the same setAnchor/retire/close API, is not determinable from this bundle.
